setlist.title: It's All Over Now Baby Blue

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Row Jimmy** (2 reviews): Jerry's majestic solo in Row Jimmy gives the reviewer chills; First set was above average, with Row Jimmy through The Music Never Stopped exceptional [14][17]
- **Slipknot!** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the post-Brent Help>Slip>Frank the best, with Vince using wild effects during Slipknot and Franklin's; Reviewer calls it the craziest Slipknot! since 3-30-90, following haunting tuning before Help on the Way [12][14]
- **Help on the Way** (1 review): The Help>Slip>Frank still gives the reviewer goose bumps [21]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Solos in Estimated Prophet and Lovelight are called glorious, with Garcia inventive throughout [17]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Reviewer watched Dark Star from the taper's section, listening through headphones [20]
- **Turn on Your Lovelight** (1 review): Lovelight includes a fake ending; reviewer also rates the closing Baby Blue extremely highly [14]

## The recordings

- **gd91-06-14.sbd.braverman.16816.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 166 min; rated 4.25/5 by 44 [1]. Said about its sound: Only a slight amount of hiss is audible on headphones; Reviewer finds the recording's downstream/stereo quality very strong, best heard without distractions; A taping problem on The Music Never Stopped makes that track difficult to listen to [12][15][23]
- **gd1991-06-14.149642.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 170 min [7]
- **gd1991-06-14.mtx.sirmick.100610.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 172 min [9]. Said about its sound: The soundboard lacked 49 seconds in Drums and 2:02 of crowd before the encore; both patched from the VHS soundtrack [9]
- **gd1991-06-14.135773.dts.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 173 min; rated 1/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Late in the first set, a man stood in his underwear on the field seats, clearing people from the area; security stayed away [18]
- Reviewer recalls a man with soiled pants and the Franklin's Tower [19]
- During Help>Slip>Frank, two very intoxicated twin girls hung on the reviewer and a lookalike near the front [20]
- Reviewer recalls chairs on the field at the start and a fire marshal threatening to stop the show unless people left the floor [21]
- The show was released as View from the Vault II; the uploader warns the unknown-SBD version may be a pirated copy [7]
- Reviewer ranks it among their top two 1991 shows, alongside the August 16 Shoreline show [12]
- Reviewer calls the Help>Slip>Frank the most complete and interesting of the 1990s [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-06-14.sbd.braverman.16816.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT> CD> SHN> Peak (track recutting and level adjustments)> SHN via Peter Braverman (possible cassette gen but NOT VFTV) [1]. Also: Possibly a cassette generation, but not from the Dead's video release View from the Vault [1]
- **gd1991-06-14.149642.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 19, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [7]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; multiple master sets were combined to make the show complete [7]
- **gd1991-06-14.mtx.sirmick.100610.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by SIRMick; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [9]. Also: Audience-sourced soundtrack from a low-generation VHS, supplied by Greyful Dave, was matched with the Braverman soundboard [9]
- **gd1991-06-14.135773.dts.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix ; SBD (shnid=16816) SBD > DAT> CD> SHN> Peak (track recutting and level adjustments)> SHN via Peter Braverman (possible cassette gen but… [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Robert F. Kennedy Stadium - June 14, 1991](https://www.dead.net/show/june-14-1991) [25]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Robert F. Kennedy Stadium - June 14, 1991](https://www.dead.net/show/june-14-1991) [26]
- Fan art by Robbi Cohn: [1991-06-14 Robert F. Kennedy Stadium, Washington, DC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-06-14-robert-f-kennedy-stadium-washington-dc-usa/) [27]
